## Expression on this line

Mathematical capacity at Order 2 is subitizing — direct, non-counting apprehension of very small
exact quantities (one, two, three) via parallel individuation of discrete objects, plus the
beginnings of impulsive one-to-one matching ("one for me, one for you," distributing items without
any counting procedure). This is protoquantitative object-tracking: the mind's object-file system
holding a small number of individuated items in parallel, not a symbolic number system. The
quantity judgment is immediate and effortless up to a small ceiling (typically three to four items)
and collapses into estimation or guessing beyond it.

The relation to quantity at this order is impulsive and magical rather than operational: "more" is
treated as an unqualified good — a taller or more spread-out array of the same objects is judged as
"more" even when the true count is unchanged, because perceptual salience (spatial extent, density)
drives the judgment rather than any conserved notion of quantity. Grabbing behavior is one-for-one
in the moment but has no persistence — the system cannot reason about a quantity once it is out of
perceptual view, and there is no reversibility (undoing a redistribution mentally).

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt urgency of scarcity/plenty — quantity as immediate affective charge rather than
  neutral fact.
- **UR:** reliable subitizing accuracy for sets of one to three or four items; consistent one-to-one
  matching behavior when distributing physical items.
- **LL:** none yet — quantity judgment is still a solitary, unshared act, though caregiver-scaffolded
  distribution rituals ("one for you, one for me") begin to appear.
- **LR:** the spatial configuration of the object array itself, which drives (and can mislead) the
  magnitude judgment.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to this stage):** impulsive quantity-grabbing that treats "more" as
  always better regardless of context, need, or fairness.
- **Dark allergy (skipping this stage):** failure to subitize even very small sets reliably — a
  floor deficit that blocks the object-tracking foundation later counting depends on.
- **Golden addiction (premature reach upward):** claiming to "count" a set when only subitizing or
  rough estimation is actually occurring — asserting a precise number the system has no procedure
  to verify.
- **Golden allergy (refusing upward):** distrusting even trivially small, reliably subitized
  quantities and insisting on laborious verification for sets well within the subitizing ceiling.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Subitizing ceiling:** accurate, immediate quantity judgment for sets of one to four items, with
  a sharp accuracy drop beyond that range.
- **Non-conservation:** magnitude judgment changes when the same set is spatially rearranged
  (spread out vs. clustered), even though true count is unchanged.
- **One-to-one matching without counting:** items are distributed in pairs/turns without any verbal
  or gestural counting procedure.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Piaget & Szeminska, *The Child's Conception of Number* (conservation experiments);
Kahneman, Treisman & Gibbs, "The reviewing of object files" (object-file theory underlying
subitizing); Feigenson, Dehaene & Spelke, "Core systems of number" (the parallel-individuation
system as distinct from the approximate number system).
**Open joints:** Does the Order 2 subitizing ceiling reflect a hard architectural limit (object-file
capacity) or a soft limit shaped by attention and task demands?
**Research debt:** pairs with `02-irritability` (the graded-magnitude precursor) and
`04-emotion-complex` (where affect-driven repetition first produces rote number-word recitation).
